tagline: Your trusted companion for PCOS awareness & daily support
landing_hero_headline: Understand your body. Take the first step.
landing_hero_subheadline: PCOS affects 1 in 5 young Indian women — most don't know they have it. Sakhi helps you check your risk in minutes, in your language, for free.
landing_stat_body: young Indian women are affected by PCOS. In Maharashtra alone, prevalence is estimated around 22.5% — yet most cases go undiagnosed.
landing_stat_source: Source: Indian Journal of Endocrinology & Metabolism
landing_what_is_pcos_body: Polycystic Ovary Syndrome (PCOS) is a common hormonal condition that can affect your periods, skin, weight, and mood. It's not a disease — it's a pattern your body shows, and understanding it early can make a big difference. Sakhi helps you notice those patterns, track your symptoms, and know when to talk to a doctor.

landing_disclaimer: Sakhi is a screening and awareness tool, not a medical diagnosis. If your results suggest moderate or high risk, please consult a healthcare professional.
